== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|The [[Starlotus]] bud is a [[spirit-fruit]] characterized by its striking appearance, featuring pale white petals with pink streaks that appear to be in a state of partial bloom. Its visual quality is often compared to the luminous aesthetic of a [[Remnant]]. While it possesses minor medicinal and herbal qualities, its primary value lies in its potent spiritual energy. [[Consuming]] the bud can significantly enhance a practitioner's [[madra]] base, making it an ideal resource for talented [[Copper]]-stage disciples seeking to advance to the [[Iron stage]]. For certain individuals, it can even facilitate an immediate breakthrough into the [[Copper]] realm. Because of its concentrated [[vital aura]], the fruit is highly prized by advanced [[sacred artists]], though it may take several days to fully digest. When consumed, the energy from the bud can be used to solidify a practitioner's foundation and fill their [[madra]] cores.}}
